description: Every posted line of an account over a period, with the balance carried forward from before it and a running balance. Give account_code for one account; leave it out for all of them, which on a real company is a lot of lines. contact_ids keeps the lines of those contacts only, each with its own balance carried forward and running balance — the detail of a row of subledger.

account_code.description: The account to detail, by its code, e.g. "400000".

account_ids.description: The accounts to detail, by id. Leave both out for every account.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.

contact_ids.description: The lines of these contacts only (from search_contacts or subledger), each with its own balance carried forward and running balance. Needs schema 0.26.0.

name: general_ledger
title: General ledger
